mapper.select: WITH visible AS () SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'DRAFT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS draft, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'REQUESTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS requested, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'NEEDS_INFO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS needs_info, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'REVIEWING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS reviewing, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'AGREED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS agreed, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'ADO_LINKED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS ado_linked, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN assigned_reviewer_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS unassigned FROM visible
